sources.title: Numberblocks Generator — Free Online Numberblocks Playground
sources.snippet:
The Numberblocks Generator is a fan-made interactive math tool built around Numberblocks, the children’s math animation where numbers become block characters. Also written as number blocks generator or numberblock generator, it lets you enter 1, 10, 1000, or a huge value, and the generator creates the matching Numberblock form so you can look at the number visually instead of only reading digits.

 Create Any Numberblock [...] The Numberblocks Generator is best understood as a visual math classifier and fan project. Instead of clearing stages, you experiment with numbers, compare patterns, and watch how a Numberblock changes when the value changes. Some players even use it like a Numberblocks calculator to check whether a number is odd, even, or a multiple. The controls stay simple so the exploration stays playful.

Move from tiny values to very large values, including numbers in the millions or higher. [...] Numberblocks Generator is an interactive math tool and fan work for generating Numberblocks, exploring clubs, and studying number patterns.

sources.title: My Preschool-Aged Son Loves Math Thanks to Numberblocks - Business Insider
sources.snippet:
Each 5-minute episode features the delightful Numberblocks, denizens of Numberland, who work together to solve various math-related challenges. The Numberblocks, primarily starring the numbers 1 through 10 but going up to 100 in later episodes, have their own distinct personalities — five is a rockstar with a star for one eye while seven is a lucky rainbow — and sing catchy tunes that will have you humming about addition and subtraction on your morning commute. [...] Like most parents of preschoolers I know, I have suffered through a lot of terrible made-for-kids programming. (Don't get me started on "Peppa Pig" or worse — "Bumble Nums.")

So when my 5-year-old son and I stumbled upon a show called "Numberblocks" during one of our great debates over an acceptable use of TV time, I did not have high expectations.

Reader, this show is a game-changer. [...] The show, which ran on the BBC's CBeebies children's channel for six seasons between 2017 and 2021, is currently streaming on Netflix.

Ever since we started watching — and it's been six straight months of "Numberblocks only!" when it's his turn to choose a show — my son has been obsessed with numbers, number patterns, and basic math functions. We'll spend dinner figuring out simple multiplication or challenging each other to count by 5s or 10s.

sources.title: Numberblocks | Learning is fun with Blocks Universe | CBeebies shows
sources.snippet:
BAFTA award-winning Numberblocks helps children to see how numbers really work − and master a new key maths skill with every adventure.  
It’s a story of friends who can always count on each other − but, most of all, Numberblocks is about having fun with numbers. [...] Each episode has been carefully crafted with the help of the NCETM (National Centre for Excellence in the Teaching of Mathematics) and brought to life by Blue Zoo Animation Studio.   
We work closely with the NCETM to make sure Numberblocks delivers the essential numeracy skills that build good number sense and a solid foundation for a lifetime of maths success.  
‍ [...] Numberblocks is designed so your child can just press play and have fun while learning essential number skills. 90 episodes take them from number names and counting to a deep understanding of how addition, subtraction, multiplication and division work, via a host of key concepts in between.

You can find your favourite characters and episodes on TV, BBC iPlayer, the Numberblocks YouTube channels and the Numberblocks World app:
